calculation.description: Ranks instruments positively when their prior 20-trading-day return is below the contemporaneous cross-sectional median, scaled by trailing 60-day realized volatility. Higher values indicate relatively oversold instruments. Uses only completed closing prices.

decay.note: Primary admission horizon is 10 trading days; other horizons were not computed in this cycle.

validation.regime_notes: Positive IC in 2025-2027 (+0.072678), 2028-2029 (+0.021643), 2030-2032 (+0.071624), and 2033-2034 (+0.028501). The available 2023-2024 segment was negative (-0.044158), so early-regime behavior warrants monitoring.
validation.methodology: Daily Spearman cross-sectional correlation of lagged factor and subsequent 10-trading-day close-to-close return; dates require at least 8 valid instruments.
